attempted_claim: Let d=2, beta in (0,1), and E_beta subset [1,2] be compact with upper Minkowski dimension beta and sup_{delta in (0,1)} delta^{beta} N(E_beta,delta) < infinity, where N(E,delta) is the delta-covering number. For lambda,t > 0 define the Bochner-Riesz means by Fourier multiplier (1-|xi|^2/t^2)^lambda_+ and the fractal maximal operator by M_{E_beta}^lambda f(x) = sup_{t in E_beta} |S_t^lambda f(x)|. For 1 < p < 2, decide the finite-exact statement: M_{E_beta}^lambda extends to a bounded operator L^p(R^2) -> L^p(R^2) if and only if lambda > lambda_c(beta,p) := max{0, 2(1/p - 1/2) - (1-beta)/2 - beta/(2p)}.
